'''Roowarra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. He was aboard [[Port Tooga]] when a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] tried to purchase [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].
